issues.title: Code points before publication?
issues.author: loadingalias
issues.body:
rscrypto, a Rust cryptography library, implements mldsa65_ed25519_sha512 and mldsa65_ecdsa_secp256r1_sha512 from this draft in its rustls provider, w/ the composite signatures of draft-ietf-lamps-pq-composite-sigs-19.

The draft's values are TBD, so we use private-use code points (0xFE41 and 0xFE40) behind opt-in features.

Do you plan to request code points before publication? Is there another implementation of the -00 text we could test against?
